generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest builds a 5-section guided tour from the repo index: architecture overview, critical paths, how to run locally, a guided reading path, and first tasks.

header.title: Onboarding for <accent>{repo}</accent>
header.subline: Generated from index of {files} files · last refreshed {relative}
header.partialTooltip: The index was bounded or incomplete, so this tour may not cover every file.

readingPath.graphOnly: Order is based on import structure only, because commit history was unavailable.

firstTasks.unavailable: First tasks are not available without generation. Regenerate once the language model is reachable.

flag_off.title: Repository analysis is turned off, so this tour has no annotations.
flag_off.next: Enable repo-intel in settings, then regenerate.

not_cloned.title: This repository has not been cloned yet, so the tour is empty.
not_cloned.next: Wait for the clone to finish (or resync the repository), then regenerate.

index_missing.title: This repository has not been indexed yet.
index_missing.next: Wait for indexing to finish, then regenerate.

index_degraded.title: The index is degraded, so only basic facts are shown.

llm_failed.title: Generation failed, so reasons and annotations are missing.

llm_invalid_output.title: The model returned output that could not be used, so annotations are missing.

stale.body: This tour was generated from an older index ({tourSha}); the repository is now at {currentSha}.
